## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix has a test that fails without it).
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased, if users can see the change.
- [ ] The serialized format and the hash are unchanged. If not, the version is bumped and the change is explained.
- [ ] Docs are plain and specific: no em or en dashes, no marketing words.
